description: writ: keeps the first user from reading git history or Claude Code conversation records

hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pretooluse.py"; else case "$(cat)" in *'"agent_type":"writ:first-user"'*|*'"agent_type": "writ:first-user"'*) echo 'writ: the first user is stopped because its check needs Python 3.9 or later; install Python 3.9 or later and run again.' >&2; exit 2;; esac; exit 0; fi
